name: app-rail
title: App Rail
description: A narrow vertical workspace nav: icon over a mono label, the active item marked with an orange left border, with pinned items at the bottom.
notes: The rail is 72px wide and fills its parent's height. Items are buttons; pass asChild to render a link. The active item gets aria-current="page". Keep labels to one short word; longer ones truncate.
On phones, hide the rail (className="hidden md:flex") and render the same items in a Bottom Tab Bar. The App Shell block does this.
